pr_comments:
And maybe `prepareConfig` has a nicer ring to it? 🚲 

I wonder if we should even let it return another config? It's faster to mutate than copy, but maybe no big deal?

> I wonder if we should even let it return another config? It's faster to mutate than copy, but maybe no big deal?

This hook already allow you to return another config. Checkout this line: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/1178/files#diff-e1f89aee8992fa7022cc43adb93042f9bbb4b223f0d6cd0e70719cf4b795afa4R164

> And maybe `prepareConfig` has a nicer ring to it?

What does "ring" mean? Does it mean "name"?  :)
This hook is imitating rollup's [options](https://rollupjs.org/guide/en/#options) hook. How about name it `options`?

> Can we move this into `resolveConfig` so it gets cached by #740?

I voted against that pr, checkout https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/740#issuecomment-736480556

> > Can we move this into `resolveConfig` so it gets cached by #740?
> 
> I voted against that pr, checkout [#740 (comment)](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/740#issuecomment-736480556)

Okay, but we should still move it into `resolveConfig`, I think.

> > And maybe `prepareConfig` has a nicer ring to it?
> 
> What does "ring" mean? Does it mean "name"? :)

https://www.gymglish.com/en/gymglish/english-translation/a-nice-ring-to-it

> This hook is imitating rollup's [options](https://rollupjs.org/guide/en/#options) hook. How about name it `options`?

I'm not a big fan of using "config" and "options" interchangeably. I think we should stick with "config" naming with a verb like "change" or "prepare" before it. Just naming it `config` might give the wrong impression.

> > I wonder if we should even let it return another config? It's faster to mutate than copy, but maybe no big deal?
> 
> This hook already allow you to return another config. Checkout this line: [#1178 (files)](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/1178/files#diff-e1f89aee8992fa7022cc43adb93042f9bbb4b223f0d6cd0e70719cf4b795afa4R164)

Sorry, I worded that confusingly. I meant we should consider *not* allowing a new config to be returned. Two reasons to do this: (1) so other plugins can keep a stable reference to the Vite config, and (2) it's at least slightly more performant to mutate the config than to copy it.

issue_context.title: Let plugin define config "optimizeDeps" and "jsx"
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Even if I am using [vite-plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react), I still have to add `jsx: "react"` to my vite config.(The same goes with preact).

Furthermore, after [the new vite-plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/34) is release, users still have to add `optimizeDeps.include: ["react", "react-dom"]` to their vite config.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Let plugin (vite-plugin-react) help users to define "optimizeDeps" and "jsx" config.

This will let vite plugin system do more and let plugin users do less.



**Describe alternatives you've considered**
No.

**Additional context**

If you are open to this idea, I can help implementing this feature.
